messages.author: d7d6f35bce833ae5
messages.subject: stat_sum and uneval data trouble
parts:
Dear All,

I am new in using R and ggplot2 so forgive me if my question sounds
too ..primitive..

I have some survey data on a csv file and I calculate from certain
pairs of questions some variables in the following way (its an
example):

hyp1x <- (d$q7!='1')+(d$q8!='1')
#Calculate x for the first hypothesis

hyp1y <- (d$q15=='No')+(d$q16=='No')+(d$q17=='No')
#Calculate y for the first hypothesis

so according to a table entry (answer) I give or not a score on the
hypothesis X axis and hypothesis Y.

Then I want to map those on a summary of values according to the
"score". I did use:

plot(hyp1x,hyp1y)

which gave an ugly result, similar results would not show
"scored" (summed) but only as circles on top of circles..

I was adviced to use stat_sum (http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_sum.html)
and it looks the most suitable for what I want to do, a simple sum on
the dimentions of x,y. However, with the following code:

tmp <- ggplot(aes(x = hyp1x, y = hyp1y))
tmp + stat_sum(aes(group = 1))

I get this error:

Error: ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class uneval

How could I check the data class?... it is a simple sum of the
answered questions and I thought it wouldnt be such a problem. Any tip
or advice would be most welcome!

Theodoros , a R/ggplot2er in early steps

messages.author: d7d6f35bce833ae5
messages.subject: Re: stat_sum and uneval data trouble
parts:
problem solved with this way:

ggplot(data.frame(x=hyp1x, y=hyp1y), aes(x = x, y = y)) + stat_sum(aes
(size = ..n..))

I made a data frame with the results prior parsing them
